payload.ticket_markdown:
## Objective
Read `ActiveState`, `MainPID` and `NRestarts` from `brittle-messages-control.service` twice and compare.

## Preconditions
1. Claim this control ticket. 2. Verify run `BRITTLE-20260729T232605Z-c5586ff7` is active and no other control work is active.

## Steps
1. Record UTC and run `systemctl --user show brittle-messages-control.service --property=ActiveState --property=MainPID --property=NRestarts --no-pager` once. 2. Wait 10 seconds. 3. Record UTC and repeat the exact command. 4. Compare. 5. Publish the report and complete.

## Acceptance
1. Exactly 2 polls, 8-15 seconds apart. 2. Each poll has exactly 3 fields. 3. Pass only if values match, `ActiveState=active`, `MainPID>0`, and `NRestarts>=0`. 4. Zero state-changing actions.

## Prohibitions
No service mutation; no production BRITTLE, code, config, Guard, training, simulation, policy, canonical-artifact, interface, promotion or `latest` changes.

## Report
Include IDs, UTC times, exact command, raw outputs, comparison, each criterion result, deviations, a no-mutation statement, local path and SHA-256.
